en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a lakeside rural scene. In the foreground is a dirt road and rocky shoreline leading to calm water with floating logs and small tree‑covered islets. On the right stands a large wooden house with decorative timber framing, alongside smaller outbuildings and coniferous trees in the background. Low hills or mountains rise in the distance across the lake. Printed caption text appears in the upper left.
